title: Spectrum

evidence.layout: Pointer table at CPU $F07A, 31 phrases with a final end bound, command-ordered. Every phrase parses and terminates in a stop frame.
evidence.independent_check: Frame count agrees with a separately built corpus: platform_lpc_frames.csv: 1478 frames; platform_trace_summary.json: 31 phrase starts.
evidence.conversion: 1478 frames converted, all keeping their frame kind when the output was re-parsed with the target tables; 23 frames below the TMS5220 pitch floor were clamped.
evidence.emulation: The converted devices were loaded into a simulation of the Squawk & Talk board -- its own 6802, PIAs and firmware -- which booted and issued the same SPEAK EXTERNAL commands as the original set.
evidence.not_verified: No converted ROM from this profile has been played on a real board. Nobody has heard it.

notes: This sound ROM set is shared by 4 game revisions: spectr4a, spectru4, spectrua, spectrum.
